name: Family Film: "Selvagens"
description: Enjoy a family-friendly film screening of "Selvagens" by Claude Barras at Porto's beautifully restored art-house cinema.
longDescription:
Batalha Centro de Cinema presents a special family film screening of "Selvagens" on June 13, 2026. This animated feature is directed by Claude Barras, known for his distinctive stop-motion animation style. The event is part of Batalha's ongoing commitment to offering diverse cinematic experiences, including programming tailored for younger audiences and families.

Attendees will experience a cinematic afternoon in the historic setting of Batalha Centro de Cinema, a landmark venue in Porto. The film is suitable for families, providing an opportunity for shared cultural engagement. The screening takes place within the beautifully restored art-house cinema, offering a comfortable and engaging environment for viewing.

Tickets for the "Selvagens" screening are available for purchase; please check the Batalha Centro de Cinema website for current pricing and availability. The cinema is centrally located and easily accessible, a short walk from Bolhão metro station and various bus stops.
